title: the-base-tool-defines-the-testing-mark-once
intention: The base tool defines the testing mark exactly once, in the public module cairn.tools.base.testing_mark, as {kind, test} riding under the field 'testing' on any artifact; 'return' is the only kind built today, a future 'perform this test' kind still reads as a mark, and DiagnosticBase stamps nothing.
why: Test against live, marked as testing (ruled 2026-09-28, extended 2026-10-04), reshaped by Akien's re-plan 2026-10-05 (/home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md 8c-8e): a testing artifact is tolerated by RETURN TO SENDER — the receiving device's shim sends a return-kind artifact back to the tester unacted on, the device never sees it, the return is the 'got here', and the tester marks that test complete. The shim and the tester need one definition of the mark to agree on, and a future 'perform this test' kind must fit it without a reshape. The first build's DiagnosticBase stamp has no reader (measured 2026-10-05) and its named consumer, a debris census, is superseded by the tester killing what it started and sweeping leftovers to logging — so it goes. Law 4: one definition, not a convention spelled at each site. RULE 1: the definition and its proof live in cairn/tools/base only.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation, Akien 2026-10-01): the mark's definition lives in one component and its proof measures only that component; Test against live, marked as testing (ruled 2026-09-28, extended 2026-10-04, reshaped 2026-10-05 to return-to-sender: the receiving shim returns a return-kind artifact to the tester, the return is the 'got here'); Law 4 (one definition, not a convention spelled at each site); ticket 71d1bbfa98b0
how: New cairn/tools/base/testing_mark.py (stdlib only): FIELD='testing', RETURN='return', KINDS=(RETURN,), mark(test, kind=RETURN) -> {'kind','test'} refusing an empty test or a kind not in KINDS with ValueError, mark_of(artifact) -> the dict under FIELD when kind and test are non-empty strings, else None. Delete cairn/tools/base/origin.py and revert DiagnosticBase.emit's origin stamp and its import (diagnostic.py returns to its bytes before 4df216c4). Charter public_interface: 'cairn.tools.base.origin' becomes 'cairn.tools.base.testing_mark' through the artifact door. The old proof test_origin_marks_what_a_test_bore.py and its validation are removed; the new proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_testing_mark_carries_a_kind.py is written red. The exact code diff rides this ticket's build_patch field.
falsifier: GREEN when cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_testing_mark_carries_a_kind.py passes all four teeth: (1) mark('t') == {'kind':'return','test':'t'}, mark('') and mark(t, kind='perform') raise ValueError; (2) mark_of returns the mark under FIELD, returns a well-formed {'kind':'perform',...} as a mark, and returns None for {}, None, a str, a non-dict field, an empty test, an empty kind and a missing kind; (3) a held DiagnosticBase emission carries neither 'origin' nor 'testing' with CAIRN_TESTER_ORIGIN set; (4) cairn.tools.base.testing_mark is in the base charter's public_interface, cairn.tools.base.origin is not, and it does not import; and test_diagnostic.py, test_device_logs_unwired.py, test_raise_trouble.py stay green. RED if any fails. WRONG INTENT if the return path needs more than kind and test to route the artifact back (then the mark carries the sender, not the envelope).
watchme: none, because the mark's readers are BaseShim (cairn/tools/base/shim.py, which will return a return-kind artifact to the tester) and the tester, whose matching of returns to test ids is the watch; both are the next children of ticket 71d1bbfa98b0
children: none, because the change is one stdlib module, a two-hunk revert in diagnostic.py and one charter string, plus its one proof already on disk at cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_testing_mark_carries_a_kind.py

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: apply exactly the unified diff carried in this ticket's build_patch field (`git apply` from a file holding that text, run in the cairn repo root). It creates cairn/tools/base/testing_mark.py, deletes cairn/tools/base/origin.py, and removes the origin import and the three-line stamp from DiagnosticBase.emit in cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py (after which `git diff 4df216c4^ -- cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py` is empty); no other code changes.

D2: SETTLED: the charter cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json replaces the one string 'cairn.tools.base.origin' in public_interface with 'cairn.tools.base.testing_mark', in place (a textual replacement, so exactly one line changes). It is written ONLY through the artifact door: build the new bytes in a scratch file, then `bin/cairn artifact write cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json --verb cast --why 'be4a7b3c7caa: cairn.tools.base.testing_mark is the one public testing mark' --from <that file>`. A direct write is refused by the artifactgate.

D3: SETTLED: the old proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_origin_marks_what_a_test_bore.py measures the replaced design and goes with the build: `git rm cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_origin_marks_what_a_test_bore.py`. It was never sealed, so no validation is removed (measured 2026-10-05: no validation under cairn/tools/base names it). The new proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_testing_mark_carries_a_kind.py stands on disk, written first as this ticket's red-first step and measured red 0/4 at HEAD ae004432 (2026-10-05: teeth 1-2 ModuleNotFoundError cairn.tools.base.testing_mark; tooth 3 the held record carried origin; tooth 4 testing_mark not in public_interface). It is committed before the BUILDME crossing; D1+D2 turn it green and do not edit it.

D4: SETTLED: after D1+D2+D3 run `python3 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_testing_mark_carries_a_kind.py` (exit 0, '4 passed'), and `python3 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_diagnostic.py`, `python3 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_device_logs_unwired.py`, `python3 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_raise_trouble.py` (each exit 0, as at HEAD). Measured so on a prototype, 2026-10-05: 4/4 green, the three neighbours exit 0.

D5: SETTLED: commit cairn/tools/base/testing_mark.py, cairn/tools/base/origin.py (deleted), cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py, cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_origin_marks_what_a_test_bore.py (deleted) and cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json together with message 'be4a7b3c7caa: the testing mark is one kind-carrying definition' and the two trailer lines 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>' and 'Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JrhBQALF5qFBEVqQJUsXUu'; the pre-commit reseal door reseals. No file outside cairn/tools/base changes.

D6: SETTLED: scope. The BaseShim return path (a return-kind artifact goes back to the tester, the device never sees it), the tester sending marked messages, matching returns to test ids, sweeping leftovers to logging and killing what a run started, and the future 'perform this test' kind are not this ticket's; the first two are sibling children of 71d1bbfa98b0, the third is built by nothing yet. The 'testing-' local constants in other components' proofs stay until the proofs-off-the-bus child rewrites them.
